title: Rich Keto Crumble
description: A rich, keto-friendly dessert featuring a crumble topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the diced potato, melted butter, and sugar substitute. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, egg, and heavy cream. Add to the potato mixture and mix until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine the crumble topping ingredients. Mix well.
Evenly spread the crumble topping over the potato mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
